is_mandatory.quote: Nothing in the Interior Design Voluntary Registration Act shall be construed to: (a) Require a person to be a registered interior designer in order to engage in an activity traditionally performed by an interior designer or interior decorator

title_protection.quote: Beginning January 1, 2025, it is unlawful for any person to use the title registered interior designer or similar description to convey the impression that such person is a registered interior designer unless the person is registered under the Interior Design Voluntary Registration Act.

scope_protection.quote: Nothing in the Interior Design Voluntary Registration Act shall be construed to: (a) Require a person to be a registered interior designer in order to engage in an activity traditionally performed by an interior designer or interior decorator

definition_quote.value: Practice of registered interior design means the design of interior spaces as part of an interior alteration or construction project in conformity with public health, safety, and welfare requirements, including the preparation of any document relating to a building code description, any project egress plan that does not require additional exits in the space affected, any space planning, any finish material, any furnishing, any fixture, any equipment, and the preparation of any document and technical submission relating to interior construction
definition_quote.quote: Practice of registered interior design means the design of interior spaces as part of an interior alteration or construction project in conformity with public health, safety, and welfare requirements, including the preparation of any document relating to a building code description, any project egress plan that does not require additional exits in the space affected, any space planning, any finish material, any furnishing, any fixture, any equipment, and the preparation of any document and technical submission relating to interior construction

architect_pathway_available.quote: A licensed architect holding a license in good standing under the Engineers and Architects Regulation Act may register with the State Treasurer as a registered interior designer without having to meet the registration requirements outlined in section 71-6105.

nonstructural_scope_only.quote: Interior nonstructural element means an element or component of a building that does not require structural bracing, is not load-bearing, and is not essential to the structural or seismic integrity of the building

value: building envelope including exterior walls, windows, and doors
egress system beyond exit access component
life safety systems including fire safety, smoke evacuation, compartmentalization, and fire-rated vertical shafts
excluded_building_systems.quote: The construction or alteration of: (A) The structural system of a building, including changing the building's live or dead load on the structural system; (B) The building envelope; (C) Any mechanical, plumbing, heating, air conditioning, ventilation, electrical, vertical transportation, fire sprinkler, or fire alarm system; (D) An egress system beyond the exit access component of such system; and (E) Any life safety system

interior_decorator_exemption.quote: Nothing in the Interior Design Voluntary Registration Act shall be construed to: (a) Require a person to be a registered interior designer in order to engage in an activity traditionally performed by an interior designer or interior decorator, including any professional service limited to the planning, design, and implementation of kitchen and bathroom spaces or the specification of products for kitchen and bathroom areas

seal_required.quote: Each registered interior designer shall obtain a seal. The design of the seal shall be determined by the State Treasurer.

responsible_control_defined.quote: Direct supervision means having full professional knowledge over work that constitutes the practice of registered interior design
